what: Clicking a same-site link covers the screen from below with an ink-colored curtain and an accent-colored panel in .72s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1) (the panel .08s later). After .24s the destination page name letters rise from 115% below, tilted 9°, 22ms apart over .6s, and then the page navigates. The arriving page stays covered with the name standing for .45s, then the letters leave toward −110% · −4° 12ms apart while the curtain and panel lift upward (the ink layer .1s later). No curtain on the first visit.

options.dur: Duration of the curtain covering and lifting (seconds), default .72 — the transition waits until fully covered, so it is delayed by this much
options.hold: Seconds the name stays on the incoming page, default .45
options.[data-fx-part=brand]: (If any) Name to place at the panel’s top left
options.data-name (on the link): Page name to show on the panel — link text if empty

note: Arriving pages are detected with sessionStorage. The user may lay a same-color cover at the page head beforehand so there is no flicker between transitions

from.where: shared.js transition curtain — original curtain module: .ri-curtain-shade and panel translateY(100%)→0 .72s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1) (panel .08s later), name letters translateY(115%) rotate(9deg) .6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) 22ms apart, navigate after 700ms · on arrival: name goes −110%, −4° .32s after .45s, curtain lifts upward (ink color .1s later)
